Oracle (ORCL) Projected to Post Earnings on Tuesday

Oracle (NYSE:ORCL – Get Free Report) is anticipated to release its Q1 2027 results after the market closes on Tuesday, September 8th. Analysts expect the company to post earnings of $1.73 per share and revenue of $19.1314 billion for the quarter. Oracle has set its Q1 2027 guidance at 1.720-1.760 EP
